points.description: Convolutional layer(s): uses kernels/filters that convolve over the input image (producing feature maps), followed by an activation layer such as ReLU.
points.partial_credit: Half if the convolutional layer is named but kernels/convolving is not mentioned, or if the activation (ReLU) is missing.

points.description: Pooling layer (max or average pooling), then one or more fully connected layers ending with a softmax output layer.
points.partial_credit: Half if only pooling or only the fully connected/softmax part is given, or if the order is clearly wrong.

rubric.notes: Full marks need the main layer types in a sensible order: convolution with kernels plus ReLU, then pooling, then fully connected layers with softmax. Give half a point where an element is missing or vague (e.g., 'filters' with no convolving idea, or no softmax). Give no marks for answers that describe a generic neural network without convolution or pooling.
